sources.title: TIPO-500M-ft: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview TIPO-500M-ft is a 500M parameter LLaMA-architecture language model trained by KBlueLeaf specifically for text-to-image prompt optimization within the TIPO framework. This model refines and extends user input prompts to improve text-to-image generation quality without requiring users to write detailed prompts themselves.
